frameConvention: original AMC frame labels, inclusive; cuts never renumbered

contacts.method: toe head <= initial standing median + 0.035 m; 12-frame centred 3D speed < 0.12 m/s; runs >= 12 frames; kinematic proxies, not force labels

directionAudit.method: world-space rig child/head-to-tip vector versus scaled ASF E-P; root has no direction
